profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, and trades under the ticker DDOG. Its website describes its core offering as cloud monitoring as a service, presenting a way to see metrics from all of an organization's apps, tools, and services in one place, with a free trial offered. The site also promotes security material, describing how integrating security and observability can help organizations decode runtime execution, reduce exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response at what the company calls agentic speed against AI-powered attacks.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001561550. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it, and the site text does not name specific product lines.
